name: quotedesk
description: RFQ-to-quote desk for trading businesses: inbound RFQ email + product URL to parallel disclosed distributor calls, configuration identity verification, and a human-approved customer quote draft.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/index.js intake --email fixtures/rfq-sample.txt && node dist/index.js run --rfq RFQ-2026-0914 && node dist/index.js quote --rfq RFQ-2026-0914 && node dist/index.js scorecard && node dist/index.js dashboard --rfq RFQ-2026-0914 && node dist/index.js verify-ledger
